result.brief: 该文用计算力学为环境、智能体及联合系统定义规范预测模型（ε-transducer/ε-machine），并给出耦合诱导的支撑受限模型及其状态分解结构，澄清不同世界模型建模对象与复杂度。
result.reason: Theoretical framework for world models of environment, agent and joint systems via computational mechanics, defining canonical predictive models and coupling-induced support-restricted states; directly addresses world-model structure.
